name: Myanmar
value: 29 civilians killed in Rakhine strikes 12–17 Nov
summary: Arakan Army says military airstrikes killed 29 civilians in Rakhine and Paletwa, 12–17 Nov; no major city changed hands
state: The Arakan Army said military airstrikes killed 29 civilians and injured 52 across six Rakhine townships and Paletwa in Chin State on 12–17 Nov, including 13 killed at the Byarla displacement camp in Ponnagyun on 13 Nov (BNI, 19 Nov; Narinjara). These figures come from one side and are not independently verified. Strikes are frequent but no major city changed hands and no cross-border escalation was found as of 19 Nov, so Watch holds.
for_you: Civilians in Rakhine and Chin states face air strikes and a blockade of supplies. FCDO advises against all travel to much of Myanmar. Rohingya refugees and border communities in Bangladesh stay exposed to new flight.
rubric_hit: Civil war at sustained intensity; repeated airstrikes but no major city fallen or cross-border escalation (Watch)
